definitions.explanation: Something or someone that serves as a standard to be copied or imitated. Used for both physical models (such as calligraphy samples) and ideal behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手本|てほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write while looking at the teacher's model.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手本|てほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧だ。
examples.english: She's an employee who serves as a role model for junior staff.

examples.japanese: ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手本|てほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せます→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧あと⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧みて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll show you an example first, then please try to do it the same way.

notes:
WRITING:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + {本|ほん} (book/origin). Originally referred to a copybook for practicing calligraphy or drawing.

USAGE:
Used both concretely (a physical model to copy from, as in calligraphy practice) and figuratively (a person or behavior to emulate). The phrase {手本|てほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ means "to set an example" or "to demonstrate."

{手本|てほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to serve as a model) can be either positive or negative depending on context — it usually implies a positive model unless qualified otherwise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手本|てほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show a model, to set an example
- {手本|てほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use as a model
- {手本|てほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a model
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{手本|てほん}: a good example
- お{手本|てほん}: model/example (polite)
